metadata.title: Emma & Noah Wedding
metadata.description: Wedding invitation website for Emma and Noah.

hero.message: We are getting married, and it would mean the world to celebrate this day with the people we love most.

image.alt: A romantic garden wedding scene at golden hour

welcome.title: We cannot wait to celebrate with you.
body: This site will hold everything guests need for the wedding day, from our story and schedule to venue details, travel notes, and RSVP.
For now, the content is intentionally easy to replace. Update this JSON file whenever the date, venue, photos, or copy are ready.

story.title: A few chapters before the big day.

milestones.title: First hello
milestones.body: We met through friends and quickly found ourselves looking for excuses to spend more time together.

milestones.title: The adventure grew
milestones.body: Weekend trips, favorite restaurants, family gatherings, and quiet everyday routines became our shared life.

milestones.title: The next promise
milestones.body: Now we are gathering everyone we love to celebrate the beginning of our marriage.

venue.title: Ceremony and celebration
venue.name: The Garden House
notes: Ceremony and reception will take place at the same venue.
Please arrive 20 minutes before the ceremony begins.
Formal or semi-formal attire is welcome.

items.title: By MRT
items.body: Take the MRT to the nearest station, then use a short taxi ride or venue shuttle.

items.title: By car
items.body: Limited parking will be available near the venue. Carpooling is encouraged.

items.title: Taxi or rideshare
items.body: Use the venue name and address above. A drop-off area will be available near the entrance.

events.title: Ceremony
events.body: We exchange vows with family and friends.

rsvp.title: Let us know if you can make it.
rsvp.body: The form is ready visually. We can connect it to a backend or external form service in the next step.
